rationale: The claim involves a rear-end motor vehicle collision resulting in a totaled vehicle and injuries to the policyholder, which falls squarely under auto coverage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 yesterday at approximately 8:15 AM by a driver traveling ~35 mph who did not brake. The vehicle is a total loss (trunk fully crushed into back seat), and Pat sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. The at-fault driver's insurance information is on file with the police report. This is a HIGH severity claim requiring prompt adjuster attention for vehicle total-loss valuation and injury follow-up. Deductible: $750; Coverage limit: $100,000.

case_facts.description: Policyholder was rear-ended by another driver traveling approximately 35 mph who did not brake. Entire trunk crushed into the back seat.
case_facts.vehicle_status: Total loss — trunk fully crushed into back seat
case_facts.injuries: Policyholder has whiplash and a sprained wrist
case_facts.third_party_info: Other driver's insurance information documented on police report
